title: 2x Kohlrabi Delicacy White Plug Plants – Salad / Cooking Vegetable - Hardy
description:
Kohlrabi Delicacy White is a

 modern, productive variety

producing

 semi-globe roots

with a

 milder flavour than the purple type

. Plants grow 9–12 inches tall and are ready to harvest in around

 55–65 days

.

 Product Details:

   Type:
  
  Kohlrabi Delicacy White (Hardy Biennial)
 

   Supplied As:
  
  2x plug plants
 

   Height:
  
  9–12 inches
 

   Flavour:
  
  Mild, less sharp than purple kohlrabi
 

   Uses:
  
  Salads, cooking, roasting, stir-fries
 

 Growing Information:

   Germination:
  
  6–10 days
 

   Temperature:
  
  15–21°C+
 

   Days to Maturity:
  
  55–65
 

   Light:
  
  Full sun
 

   Sowing/Planting Months:
  
  March–August
 

   Harvest Months:
  
  June–September
 

 Tips:

  Prefers cool weather with consistent moisture.
 

  Plant in fertile, well-drained soil.
 

  Thin to 10 inches apart once established.
 

  Mulch around the base to retain moisture.
 

  Water well in hot or dry spells.
 

  Harvest when bulbs reach about 3 inches in diameter.
